articles.title: Voyager 1 Nears a One-Light-Day Milestone
articles.summary: Almost 50 years after launch, Voyager 1 is nearing one light-day from Earth, kept alive by a clever power-saving upgrade after a mysterious two-day silence.

articles.title: Museum Frogs Solve a 50-Year Vanishing Mystery
articles.summary: Museum frogs preserved decades ago have revealed that a deadly fungus swept through Brazil's Atlantic Forest just as frog populations collapsed in the late 1970s.

articles.title: Ice Age Europeans Were Far More Connected Than We Thought
articles.summary: Ancient DNA shows Ice Age Europeans mixed across vast distances far earlier than thought, while some groups sheltered for thousands of years in Spain and Portugal.
